title: Linux arm64 build not run: Goose has no linux-arm64 release
what: Goose has no linux-arm64 release and building it from source is not documented in the release, so the Linux arm64 build (Appendix D) is not run.
why: DECISIONS.md D-14-GOOSE: platform is macOS arm64 only so far.
impact: No Linux arm64 verification of the Goose core.
workaround: Linux amd64 container gate runs under emulation.
